newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down vs US dollar on intervention.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down vs US dollar on intervention.

text.p: The Chinese yuan moved down in dull trading to close at 8.2978 against the U.S. dollar on Monday from last Friday's 8.2970 due to intervention by the central bank, traders said.

The yuan opened slightly up at 8.2968 and hit an intra-day high of 8.2965 early in the session. It then fell to consolidate in a narrow range between 8.2975 and an intra-day low of 8.2980 for the rest of the session.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.2975, traders said.
Dealers said trading interest had weakened ahead of the year-end, resulting in dull trading.
"Buying for the local unit in the market was limited and only seen early in the session," one dealer said. "A little intervention from the central bank pushed the yuan down."
Dealers expected the yuan to remain stable around 8.2980 in dull trading for the remainder of this week.
The yuan closed up slightly at 7.2420 from 7.2550 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0714 from 1.0726 against the Hong Kong dollar.
